Title: Rishabh's Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 8 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Aditi - 8 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Anita - 39 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Karan - 36 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
5. Nikhil - 10 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Anita, Aditi and Karan stand near him.]

Aditi: "What lovely weather!"

[Rishabh goes jogging in the park.]

Rishabh: "Yes, all right."

[Rishabh catches the ball.]

Karan (happily): "Hmm, I see."

[Rishabh kicks the football hard.]

Karan: "What happened?"

[Rishabh swings on the swing.]

Karan: "Oh wow!"

[Rishabh goes down the slide.]

Rishabh: "Oh wow!"

[Rishabh feeds the birds.]

Rishabh (happily): "Show me too!"

[Rishabh does push-ups.]

Aditi: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The main road - Day

Anita: "Rishabh, look over here."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Rishabh sits in the back seat.]

Karan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rishabh sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Karan: "Show me too!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Aditi, Anita and Nikhil stand near him.]

Anita: "Aditi, look over here."

[Rishabh puts on his school uniform.]

Rishabh: "Yes, of course."

[Rishabh combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Rishabh (laughing): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Nikhil: "Yes, all right."

[Aditi applies kajal to her eyes.]

Aditi: "And then?"

[Aditi puts on red lipstick.]

Aditi: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aditi puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Aditi: "What next?"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

Rishabh: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh dances to the music.]

Rishabh: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rishabh whispers something to Mother.]

Karan (excited): "How beautiful!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Rishabh: "I really enjoyed today."
